Name: Menu Blur
Author: xzcute
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lm2DKj5.png[/img][/center]
[center][url=https://smapi.io][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI-4.5.0+-brightgreen.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/License-CC%20BY--NC--SA%204.0-lightgrey.svg[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://img.shields.io/badge/GMCM-Compatible-purple.svg[/img][/url] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Windows%20|%20macOS%20|%20Linux-lightgrey.svg[/img][/center]
[center][size=4]Adds a frosted-glass blur behind menus - the game world keeps moving underneath it. [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Blurs whatever is behind open menus in real time - updates as the world moves.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Three blur types: [b]Gaussian[/b] (smooth), [b]Bokeh [/b](shaped aperture), [b]Motion[/b] (directional).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Turns itself off during building placement, animal purchasing, and museum donations so you can still see what's underneath.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Runs at a lower resolution with an adjustable refresh rate - drop the interval if you're hitting frame issues.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Strength, pass count, dimming, and brightness are all configurable.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Installation[/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install [/size][url=https://smapi.io][size=4]SMAPI[/size][/url][size=4] 4.5.0 or newer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download Menu Blur and extract the folder into your [/size][i][size=4]Stardew Valley/Mods[/size][/i][size=4] directory.[/size][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you want to change settings without editing the config file by hand.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Configuration[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Enabled [/b]- Turn it on or off. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur Type[/b] - Gaussian, Bokeh, or Motion. Default: Gaussian.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Bokeh Shape[/b] - Circle, Hexagon, Star, Heart, or Diamond. Default: Hexagon.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Bokeh Size[/b] - Size in pixels. Default: 2px.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur Strength[/b] - Higher = stronger fog. Default: 4x.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur Passes[/b] - More passes = softer result. Default: 1.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Motion Direction[/b] - Angle in degrees. Default: 0°.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Update Interval[/b] - 1 = every frame, higher = less GPU load. Default: 6.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Dim Strength[/b] - Darkness of the tint. Default: 0%.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur Brightness[/b] - Brightness of the blurred layer. Default: 100%.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur during dialogue[/b] - Show while NPCs talk. Default: Off.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Blur during fishing[/b] - Show during fishing minigame. Default: On.[/size][/*]
[/list]
[heading][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][size=4]Stardew Valley 1.6 and up.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Supports Generic Mod Config Menu.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Works with UI scaling and high-resolution monitors.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Compatible with most other UI mods.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][i]Made for the Stardew Valley community by [b]xzqute[/b][/i][/size][/center]
